messages:
Maria: FYI — NimbleRetail (mid-market). Renewal ~28 days. Signals: onboarding stalled at feature flags, quota spikes, DAUs dropping. I think this is a high-propensity churn risk. Can we spin a quick 10-day save plan?

Jake: Can you paste the recent metrics? seats enabled vs seats used, DAU trend, last active date

Maria: Quick snapshot: 40 seats purchased, 12 ever logged in, DAU down 22 -> 7 in last 30d, last API event 11 days ago, spikes from two unknown jobs that hit quota. Renewal in 28 days.

Anita: Proposed play: 1) unblock (support + flag fix), 2) 10-day enablement + paired sessions, 3) graceful downgrade option if no traction. Goal: decide within 10 days. Keeps customer in platform and preserves data.

Paul: I’ll open the support case and look at the quota logs. Creating ticket now and will triage the flag config. @ops-bot please create SR.

ops-bot: Support SR-35218 created for NimbleRetail 14 assigned to Paul. First response ETA 45m.

Jake: Outreach cadence I’m thinking: Day 0 product check (20m), Day 2 pair-program session, Day 5 progress report + exec summary, Day 9 renewal prep + downgrade offer if needed. Short and measurable.

Maria: Need copy for Day 0 and for the downgrade offer that emphasizes no data loss and easy re-upgrade window.

Anita: Day 0 email draft:

```
Hi <Name>  I'm Maria on Redwood CS. We saw a flag/quota issue blocking your rollout. Can we do a quick 20-min session to finish the setup and confirm your top 3 flows? Available today 34pm PT or tomorrow 1011am PT.
```

Anita: Downgrade offer (short):

```
If you need to reduce spend while finishing rollout, we can move you to a temporary Essentials plan for 30 days with no data loss. Well include 1:1 enablement and a guaranteed re-upgrade window.
```

Paul: Success gates to avoid downgrade: 60 active users OR 2,500 tokens generated OR 3 completed workflows within 10 days. Hitting any gate = resume normal plan and trigger renewal conversation.

Oliver: From Product  we can add a lightweight telemetry flag that surfaces failed flag evaluations to CS as an early warning. I'll open a ticket for a non-prod hook.

Jake: I'll make a checklist in the CSM UI called "nimble-low-use-10d-save" and attach the outreach templates + metric gating. Will link it to the account record.

Maria: Owners:
- Paul: run support triage + flag fix (today)
- Maria: send Day0 outreach + attach usage snapshot
- Anita: run enablement schedule and host pair-program sessions
- Jake: create playbook/checklist and automation
- Oliver: telemetry hook

Maria: We'll capture feedback after the Day 2 pair-program with three quick NPS-style questions (value, blockers, confidence). If value < 6 escalate to Product for fast follow-up.

Maria: Update me in thread after Day 0 call. If metrics hit gates, we escalate to renewal prep; if not, apply the temporary downgrade on Day 10 and continue enablement. :thumbsup:
